user.title: Connect to LogShed
user.description: Configure connection to your LogShed instance.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure LogShed
reconfigure.description: Change the address of your LogShed instance. The API token stays the same.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with LogShed
reauth_confirm.description: Your LogShed API token has expired or is invalid. Please provide a new token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to LogShed instance. Please check the host URL and network.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token or insufficient permissions (requires 'system:read' scope).
error.invalid_host: Invalid host URL. Format should be http://host:port or https://host:port.

abort.already_configured: This LogShed instance is already configured.
abort.wrong_instance: This is a different LogShed instance from the one configured in this entry.

enable_maintenance.name: Enable Maintenance Window
enable_maintenance.description: Starts an on-demand LogShed maintenance window to silence alerts and optionally drop error logs. Returns the session ID of each window it starts.

config_entry_id.name: LogShed Instance
config_entry_id.description: The LogShed instance to start the window on. Starts one window on every loaded instance if omitted.

duration_minutes.name: Duration (Minutes)
duration_minutes.description: Duration of the maintenance window in minutes (1 to 1440).

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Reason for the maintenance window for audit logs.

target_app.name: Target App
target_app.description: Optional filter to drop errors only from a specific application or container.

target_host.name: Target Host
target_host.description: Optional filter to drop errors only from a specific host machine.

disable_maintenance.name: Disable Maintenance Window
disable_maintenance.description: Ends LogShed maintenance windows. Pass the session ID returned by Enable Maintenance Window to end only that window; without a session ID, every on-demand window is ended, including windows started from the LogShed web UI, MCP clients or other automations. Scheduled windows are never ended.

config_entry_id.name: LogShed Instance
config_entry_id.description: The LogShed instance to end windows on. Applies to every loaded instance if omitted.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The maintenance session to end, as returned by Enable Maintenance Window. If omitted, every active on-demand session is ended.
